Name: Fancy Rings and Shoes Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=4][b][center][color=#fff2cc]Compatible with Stardew 1.6[/color][/center][/b]

Currently added retexture for all vanilla shoes and rings [color=#ff7700][u][b]EXCEPT[/b][/u] [b][u]COMBINED RINGS[/u][/b][/color][color=#ff7700] [/color]- dunno how it works  exactly (It uses some fancy ingame coding for sure) but every time new combined ring looks just wrong.
[b][u]SO PLEASE[/u][/b] after combining your rings in the forge - [b][u]disable retexture for those two rings in config[/u][/b] so it won't look like overlapped pixel mess.
(If you are familiar with smapi coding and would like to help with it, it would be very, very nice).

For example - after combining iridium band and amethyst ring, go to config and uncheck them there).
